name: branding-navy-blue-hex-logo-letterhead-and-orange-blue-angle-header-sheet
title: Navy Hex Letterhead and Orange-Blue Angle Header
whatItIs: Two letterheads: a navy and sky-blue sheet with a hexagon logo, headline, date and heavy top and bottom curved bands, and a sheet on a brown wood-grain ground with an angular blue and orange header over a small ornament logo.
whatItMeans: Curved versus angular corner bands give different personalities, calm corporate or energetic, using the same page structure.
techniques: Heavy curved bands top and bottom
Angular stacked stripes in blue and orange
Centred logo over a headline row
Warm wood backdrop behind a cool sheet
Icon contact row above the footer band

vocabulary.definition: A block of solid colour spanning the page width.
A header built from diagonal slices of colour.
A wood texture used as a mockup surface.
